image_review.rule: Save dataset start/native reset/recorded goal galleries for every eligible case. Pause before controller episodes for explicit visual review. Shape/dtype, native state or flagged photometric mismatch is technical, not an outcome-based replacement rule.

pilot_selection.rule: First min(8,N) eligible development_training episodes in the frozen ascending source order. Freeze those IDs before reading any controller outcome; no evaluation or selection-panel episode may enter pilot training.

selection_rule: Within each fixed public episode, scan source0,5,... ascending; for each source test endpoint offsets100,75,50,25 in that order. Admit first pair with endpoint XY displacement60..160px and native start not already successful. For islands use the recorded route point closest to half cumulative arclength (first point on exact ties) as centre. Require endpoint disk clearances>=margin+frozen motion allowance+2px. Conditions are assigned by numeric episodeID modulo4 before any pixel/model/controller outcomes. Retain every rejected candidate and inadmissible episode; never replace outside enumerated pools. Final-pool pixels and interventions remain untouched.
accounting: At most28explicitnative resets, zero native actions, zero neural model queries. All native render_frame invocations including native reset goal-image generation counted separately from public pixel reads. HDF5 hash read, XY/pixel reads and elapsed preparation time preserved. No historical managed job is resumed.
